opening.quote: Good a morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Could I take your full name and the order number i or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and order number or postcode before discussing the order, but the caller gave only 'Tom Smit' and the order number was misheard, so confirm the full name and the exact order number before sharing order details.

understanding.quote: So you've opened a dispute with your bank about this payment?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue as a bank dispute and did not re-ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Bank disputes are handled by our Payments team, so I've passed your case to them with so all the details. They'll replys to you by email within 2 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 2-working-day Payments timeline was stated correctly, and no other amounts or timelines were wrongly given, though you read back order 639184 when the caller gave 63918, so confirm order numbers before quoting them.

process_compliance.quote: Bank disputes are handled by our Payments team, so I've passed your case to them with so all the details.
process_compliance.comment: You correctly passed the bank dispute to the Payments team without handling it yourself, as the policy requires.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it got to that point, I can hear this has a hassle.
communication.comment: You acknowledged the caller's frustration politely, which meets the communication standard.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the Payments team will reply within 2 working days, asked if there was anything else, and closed politely.
